_why: Kernel routes the assistant cannot reach. A WORKLIST, not an allowance: it may only shrink. Each is a capability a person has and Cobb does not, which is how he came to print a stage direction instead of grouping two nav sections. Give one an action (// AI-ACTION: <id>) or say why it should never have a door (// AI-REACH: <reason>), then delete its line. A NEW kernel route cannot be added here: it says which it is on the day it is written.

unreachable.bundles.ts PATCH /:x/features: needs an action to turn a bundle's optional parts on or off
unreachable.bundles.ts POST /history/:x/revert: needs an action that previews what a revert puts back before it runs
unreachable.bundles.ts POST /install: needs an action that installs a bundle from the catalog, shown as a card first
unreachable.instances.ts POST /:x/scan-fallback: needs an action to name the table a scan lands in when nothing else fits
unreachable.quickstart.ts POST /materialize: needs an action that builds the workspace from the quickstart answers, as a card
